name: C&K Woodworks - Live Edge Wood Furniture and Supplier
old_description: Whether you’re looking for the perfect live edge slab for your next DIY project or you need an skilled craftsman to create a custom table or bar top just for you, we can help.
about:
C&K Woodworks operates from a warehouse in Oak Park, Michigan, where founders Chris and Kai have spent roughly five years building a business around live-edge lumber and custom woodworking. The pair began by sourcing and drying slabs for their own projects, then opened the inventory to local makers and designers.

The shop produces custom tables, bar tops, countertops, and shelving, while also selling raw live-edge slabs for DIY builds. All lumber is locally sourced, hand-selected, and kiln-dried to 6–8% moisture content to stabilize the wood for interior or exterior use. A board-planing service prepares slabs to uniform thickness before fabrication or pickup.

Customers range from homeowners furnishing a dining room to commercial clients outfitting offices and hospitality spaces. The warehouse doubles as a showroom where buyers can inspect slabs in person and consult on design details before production begins.

Chris and Kai emphasize a hands-on, educational approach—walking clients through wood species, finish options, and joinery choices—so that each piece reflects the buyer’s vision rather than a catalog standard.
